excerpts.text: My husband has several food allergies and during our trip to NYC, this restaurant was a breath of fresh air. Our server, Juli, was so kind and accommodating to my husband's needs. … The owner Anthony and his manager Heron welcome you like you are family and remember you when you come back. Great food and wonderful accommodations for all allergies. In fact, the first thing the server will ask is, "are there any allergies at the table?" Then the rest of your meal is flawlessly delivered to your specifications.

Food allergies?? BEWARE!!! My daughter ate here on New Year's Eve which resulted in her falling ill due to a severe allergic reaction caused by eating gluten. She was then taken by ambulance to Mount Sinai emergency department for urgent medical treatment. Despite the good reviews and reassurances by staff that her food would be gluten-free it clearly was not. …
